Actor Ranvir Shorey receives death threat over CJP protest participation

Actor Ranvir Shorey has filed a police complaint after receiving a death threat. The threat, which involved being hit on the head from behind with a rod, was reportedly linked to his participation in a protest organized by the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP). One report described the protest as "goondaraj in the name of saving democracy."
